STATE UNIVERSITY HOSTEL ADMINISTRATION
OFFICE OF THE CHIEF WARDEN
Vidya Vihar Campus, University Road, Pin - 500007

CIRCULAR: HOSTEL MAINTENANCE & CAUTION DEPOSIT CHARGES
Circular Ref No: SU/HA/2026/FEE-002
Date: 10 October 2026

SUBJECT: Remittance of Hostel Maintenance Fee and Caution Deposit for Odd Semester 2026

1. NOTICE TO RESIDENTS:
All boarders residing in Boys Hostels (Blocks 1 to 4) and Girls Hostels (Blocks 1 to 3) are hereby instructed to clear the prescribed hostel maintenance charges and refundable caution deposit for the current semester.

2. FEE PARTICULARS:
- Semester Hostel Maintenance Fee: INR 12,500 (Non-Refundable)
- Caution Deposit: INR 5,000 (Refundable upon vacating)
- Total Amount Payable: INR 17,500
- Mode of Payment: Online through SBI Collect portal under category 'SU Hostel Fee'. No cash or draft accepted.

3. SUBMISSION DEADLINE:
Students must complete the payment within a fortnight of publication of this circular or shortly before the commencement of the mid-semester examinations. Failure to remit within the stipulated period will attract standard late fines as decided by the hostel committee.

4. REQUIRED ACTIONS:
- Visit SBI Collect and select State University Hostel Board.
- Enter student roll number and select hostel block.
- Complete payment using UPI, Net Banking, or Debit Card.
- Retain the e-receipt and submit one hardcopy to the Hostel Caretaker office for mess card validation.

5. CONTACT:
Office of the Chief Warden, Administrative Wing, Room 12.
Email: hostel-office@stateuniv.edu.in
